location.pt: Esgotos: à direita do santuário atrás de uma porta do Guardião, abaixo do ralo.

hint.en: How to get it: Lend Ellie some money while she shops in the General Store. Inside: 2× Cursed Die, 1× Lucky Die, 1× Crimson Die.

hint.en: How to get it: Random: tier 1 book loot in the Mall Mines. Inside: 1× Aged Rum, 1× Small Coin Pouch, 1× Fickle Potion of Greed, 1× Fickle Potion of Panic, 1× Fickle Potion of Daring, 5× Gold Ore, 1× Mystery Sandwich.

hint.en: How to get it: Talk to Molly in her workshop. Inside: 3× Assorted Gems, 2× Treasure Casket, 1× Gem Bag, 1× Blood Potion.

hint.en: How to get it: Talk to Alice while she is at the farmhouse. Inside: 1× Gem Bag, 2× Treasure Casket, 1× Love Potion, 2× Spiced Sausage, 1× Cured Mana Steak.
